answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support zero-knowledge rate-limit proofs tied to a Semaphore identity and per-epoch nullifier. A valid message exposes only its share; repeating the same signal in that epoch produces a second share, allowing anyone to interpolate the private key. The verifiable recovery proof triggers immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly; jade and quill may label test agents, but cannot bypass this rule.
